senses.gloss: तत 1. tatá, m. father: vc. also my son.
तत 2. ta-tá, pp. of √ 1. tan.

तात tāta, m. father;
 voc. dear (addressing 🞄elders, superiors, children, or pupils).
ततस्त्य tatas-tya, a. coming from thence.
ततामह tatā-mahá, m. grandfather.
तति 1. tá-ti, a. pl. so many (nm., ac. táti).
तति 2. ta-ti, f. multitude, troop.
ततिथ tati-thá, a. (ī́) the so-manieth.
तत्तीर tat-tīra, n. its bank.
तत्रचक्षुर्मनस् tatra-cakṣur-manas, a. directing 🞄eyes and thoughts thither.
तत्रत्य tatra-tya, a. being there.

तत्रभवत् tatra-bhavat, a. respected;
 m. the 🞄gentleman there: -ī, f. the lady there (of persons 🞄absent from the stage).
तत्रस्थ tatra-stha, a. being or abiding there.
तत्रान्तरे tatra‿antare, lc. in the interval, 🞄meanwhile.
तात् tā́t, (ab. of ta) ad. thus, in this wise (V.).

तात्त्विक tāttv-ika, a. real;
 possessing the 🞄true doctrine (of the Jains).
तात्स्थ्य tātsth-ya, n. being contained therein.
